title: Elegy to a Missing Friend
overview: In the aftermath of her friend's passing, an artist processes her grief by making a film. She weaves her personal archival footage and an unfinished science-fiction narrative into a deeply raw and emotive work of art.

title: The Bluey Movie
overview: On an action-packed day, a big surprise changes everything for Bluey and her family.

title: To Bontang
overview: She is worth every mile, every inch, and every heartbeat.

title: Rattakus
overview: After a rebellion is crushed by the rats in the sewers of Los Santos, the rats return to a mostly peaceful life until Rattakus is forced to make a difficult decision that will change the fate of every rat in Los Santos.

title: Wings of Freedom
overview: Home-loving eagle Salana is forced out of her jungle bird colony to join Pirro, an intrepid swift and member of the Animal Air Force. This unlikely duo embarks on an epic, high-flying adventure to stop a malevolent AI and save the world.

title: Dive 2: The Journey Continues
overview: Vignesh, a skilled swimmer, thinks winning in the pool is all he needs for success. But when his teammate Aanya quits swimming to focus on studies, he starts rethinking his choices. Struggling with school and swimming, Vignesh feels lost until his mom encourages him to find balance. With hard work, he improves in both and learns that real success comes from giving your best in all areas of life.

title: Sonic the Hedgehog 4
overview: Sonic the Hedgehog, joined by a new hero named Amy, faces a new technological nemesis known as Metal Sonic.

title: Panic Carefully
overview: Described as a paranoid thriller about a hunt for a cyber-terrorist in the vein of Mr. Robot and The Silence of the Lambs.

title: Dust Bunnies
overview: A man's quiet night at home turns into a battle for survival when he unwittingly mixes a box of chemicals with the dust in his garbage unleashing a swarm of violent, hungry dust bunnies.

title: The Third Parent
overview: A neighborhood Fourth of July celebration is interrupted by a ferociously bizarre anomaly who overpowers a family in order to teach them how to become better people and more compliant citizens.

title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
original_title: The Curse of the Silver Chain
overview: A silver chain that appears for centuries made by warlocks in the 15th century.

title: The Inmate
overview: About an inmate who fears the outside world.

At 8:38 PM, May wakes up in a room with no memory. With one lifeline call, she must uncover the truth, before it’s too late. But is the voice helping her… or hiding something darker? 8 minutes is all she has.

title: Artificial
overview: Described as a comedic drama set in the world of artificial intelligence, around the period at OpenAI in 2023 that saw CEO Sam Altman fired and rehired in a matter of days.

title: Focker-in-Law
overview: Henry, son of Greg and Pam Focker, faces family chaos when he decides to marry a strong-willed woman who appears to be his complete mismatch.

title: Cameron Winter at Carnegie Hall
overview: A concert film documenting Cameron Winter's sold-out performance at Carnegie Hall.

title: In Transit
overview: Late one night, rideshare driver Ayaan Malik accepts what appears to be an ordinary request. But when his mysterious passenger refuses to provide a destination, a routine ride descends into an unsettling journey through empty streets, repeating roads, and a reality that no longer makes sense.  As the night unfolds, Ayaan begins to question everything around him—including the passenger in his back seat, the city outside his window, and whether some rides are meant to end at all.  IN TRANSIT is a psychological thriller exploring isolation, choice, and the terrifying possibility that some paths cannot be escaped once they're taken.

title: Clayface
overview: Matt Hagen's meteoric rise from Gotham street kid to Hollywood leading man is tragically cut short when a local crime boss's actions leave him horribly disfigured. Abandoned by his team and with nothing left, Matt seeks out a cutting edge treatment that miraculously returns him to his former self… but also unexpectedly affects his grip on reality, spiraling him down a destructive path of all-consuming revenge.

title: flow
overview: A young person records a quiet walk through the woods. What begins as a casual video slowly reveals something harder to say.

title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
original_title: Wuthering Heights: The House of the Damned
overview: Mr. Lockwood arrives at the remote and storm-battered Wuthering Heights, unaware that Catherine's vengeful ghost walks its halls. Her obsessed lover, Heathcliff, feeds her bloodlust with human sacrifice, hoping to give her soul a new body to inhabit. As Lockwood grows sick and delusional, he is drawn deeper into their deadly, undying love, and must escape before he becomes their next victim.

title: Dolioo
overview: Sarah Jamson, daughter of Hudson’s murdered ally, wages a one-woman war against Hudson, using stealth, strategy, and vengeance-marked corpses to haunt him psychologically. Chloe Varenne, a symbol of lost love and innocence, becomes the spark that pushes KAEL toward rebellion.

title: Jeffrey Dollmer
overview: Models on a photo shoot are stalked by a doll possessed by the spirit of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer.

title: The Fall of Barsisa
overview: A modern re-imagining of the fable of the same name. Three brothers leave their ailing sister in the company of a devout and honourable figure as they are guided by an ambiguous stranger through treacherous terrain in search of a remedy.

title: How Hard Can It Be?
overview: Mallory, an ambitious New York reporter, is assigned to a story on the Best Small Town in America, sending her to Alabama. Mallory stays at a BnB run by Robin and her charming son Wren, a former Marine. Beneath her exterior, Mallory’s warm side is revealed as she bonds with the community, especially Wren. Zeke, Mallory’s best friend and Hollywood heartthrob, visits her there and challenges her to rethink what she really wants.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
original_title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: The Maggots
overview: Yinfeng’s abusive father is seriously ill when she is far away from home. What will she do about this blood relationship that has caused her so much pain?

title: The Legend of Captain Scarlet
overview: Inspired by the Super Space Theatre compilations of the 1980s. An exclusive new feature-length New Captain Scarlet movie experience.

title: STOMACH BOOK: The Caput Mortuum Tour Documentary
original_title: STOMACH BOOK: The Caput Mortuum Tour Documentary
overview: A home video style documentary following a band of trans women as they tour westward across the United States and Canada.

title: Disney Channel Mitmachkino (2026) September
overview: Does going to the movies mean lights out, quiet, and sitting still? Not at the Disney Channel Interactive Cinema! Here, children can sing along, dance, clap, and solve riddles for an entire hour – anything but being quiet! On the big screen, Mickey Mouse, as the animated host of the 2026 Cinema Festival, guides moviegoers through the colorful program, designed for the youngest viewers of preschool age, offering approximately 65 minutes of child-friendly, interactive cinema. Tickets are only €5!

title: Faith
overview: Gina, a hard-working and devoted single mother, meets a quietly enigmatic stranger, Michael. The presence of someone who appears to care for her brings a new and exciting dynamic to her life, despite the fact she knows nothing about him or what his intentions towards her really are. Is he a friend, a potential lover or something more sinister?

title: Black Forest
overview: Jack and Alice find a video camera while hiking in the woods. As he reviews the footage, Jack’s sanity is pushed to the limits as the people he watches calls out to him looking for his soul.

title: This Time, I Mean It
overview: This Time, I Mean It, is a Comedy Drama that follows the story of Sam, who must fight against time to stop his girlfriend from leaving his life forever.

title: Trash Mountain
overview: A twenty something gay man travels from Chicago to his home in rural Missouri following the death of his father — an obsessive hoarder who has left a house full of items, some valuable and some not so, to pick through.

title: On The Cutting Room Floor
overview: When two filmmakers, Lana and Keith, become entangled in each other's lives, personally and professionally, it becomes apparent that their relationship is less stable than it seemed.

title: They Called Me a Rabble-Rouser
overview: A Queer elder in rural Maine reflects on her journey from cities of millions to a village of one thousand.

title: Habib is Cary Grant
overview: A man takes a stroll in the city!

title: The Sunsets in the West
overview: A folk duo begins to have issues when one of them wants to leave the band and pursue music with their girlfriend instead.

title: The Housewife
overview: A young New York Times journalist tracking down a potential Nazi officer living secretly in Queens.

title: The Echo Chamber
overview: Leo and Ava chase each other—coming close, drifting apart, and searching for their way back. They cannot let go, nor break free. Through the rooms, Ava’s voice echoes across time, carrying to the surface what endures—and what can no longer be held back.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: No Better Time
overview: Private View Episode 5. First came the plagues and the fire, then the high seas just got higher...

title: Symposium
overview: Two men meet in an abandoned lot.

title: Le Trident
overview: A young man finds himself at a party stumbling when socializing with three women; a complicated friendship, a chance fling, and a reawakened crush.

title: JunkTown: Far Away and Long Ago
original_title: JunkTown: Far Away and Long Ago
overview: Ten years after JunkTown: A Love Letter, Hunter Whaley returns to Colorado to help spread his grandfather's ashes. Much has changed, little has stayed the same. From the rapidly developing sprawl of Grand Junction to the unpaved roads of Yampa, Far Away and Long Ago is an ode to the passage of time and the lasting bonds of friends and family.

title: Faux Amis
overview: Adele and May, two American twenty-somethings with different backgrounds and a less than sturdy friendship, travel together to Paris so that Adele can finally unite with the handsome Jacques, an (unbeknownst to the women) reclusive local there who has been courting Adele from across the Atlantic via Instagram. The city is not kind to their relationship.

title: Bayi Ngomong Kiamat
overview: A group of old friends film a mockumentary "reunion" with the man once viral as the "baby who spoke of doomsday" unaware his curse is still very much alive, and that hearing him say "kiamat" could now be fatal.

title: Hong Kong, Let's Get Married
overview: This documentary follows Hong Kong’s same-sex marriage movement through court challenges, activism, and personal stories as couples and advocates pursue recognition and equality.

title: Love, Rendered
overview: Follows an octogenarian couple: Burt is losing his memory; his loving wife Ethelle wants him to retain their most meaningful memories together.

title: Phytophonics
overview: Plant matter is used to create finely detailed indexical traces on photochemical film. The traces are not only visible but also audible. Eco-punk against the abyss created by late-capitalism.

title: CHAT
overview: A family's fresh start unravels when their son discovers an AI powered tablet, unleashing a wave of terror tied not only to the supernatural but to dark secrets of greed and corruption that surround them.

title: Zero Intention of Living Quietly
overview: Mistreated by people unable to cope with his unique visible difference, actor Adam Pearson glimpses a path away from isolation through his love of cinema. Upon meeting kindred spirit Ellie - a girl who shares his genetic condition, NF1 - their quest begins to forge a new type of movie hero, and finally press play on life.

title: Nighthawks
overview: A young couple explores their relationship throughout three crucial moments in their lives

title: Dark Hollow
overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

title: Famous Last Words: Gloria Steinem
overview: Before her death, activist Gloria Steinem shared her final, heartfelt message with the world, knowing this interview would not air until she was gone.

title: Sorry Trail's Closed
overview: A young man goes on a hike. His usual trail is closed and he’s about to find out that sometimes you gotta just turn back around.

title: The Second Location
overview: A family with something lurking in their basement...

title: Ghost Buddies: The Gathering
overview: A group of friends gather for a birthday weekend in a "rented" house that's haunted. Their ghost-hunting friend, Connor, secretly seeks a possessed plush toy, causing chaos. He must find and exorcise the toy without alerting his friends.

title: Stolen Babies
overview: Told by the mothers and children who were separated from one another, this landmark documentary reveals the full scale of the UK's forced adoption scandal. Over four decades, 250,000 unmarried mothers were forced by the British state to give up their babies. Their first-hand accounts expose the system that tore families apart, its lasting impact, and the fight to uncover the truth that led to a moment of national reckoning.

title: Como Dominar o Mundo (ou Meninos Mimados)
original_title: Como Dominar o Mundo (ou Meninos Mimados)
overview: While Marcelo and his childhood friends, João Gabriel and João Tadeu, wait to watch the Flamengo game, Marianne, his ex-girlfriend, sends him a voice message saying that her intimate photos have been leaked. Unsure of how to react and prompted by one of the Joãos, Marcelo starts a conversation about whether young people like them could take over the world.

title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
overview: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

title: Brandon & Haider
overview: When the enigmatic allure of two ancient artifacts is unleashed, two students are bestowed with unparalleled powers. Yet, a relentless collector, driven by an insatiable thirst for dominion, will stop at nothing to seize them, igniting a cataclysmic battle that will determine the fate of worlds

title: Claire McKenna
overview: After years of addiction and isolation, Claire McKenna is finally home from rehab. It’s her first day back—and her first day of probation.  Anxiously awaiting her parole officer, Claire discovers something from her old life that suddenly puts her fragile new beginning into question.  To everyone around her, the moment may seem insignificant. For Claire, it’s a fierce and deeply personal battle to remain sober, honest, and alive.

title: LOOP
overview: In a near-future world where technology has rendered most human labor obsolete, Zoe Pearce, a despairing artist, finds herself selected as a finalist for the universe challenge. This exclusive competition promises membership in humanity's most coveted experience: complete digital personalized immersion, where pain, suffering, and unwanted emotions are eliminated.

title: Super Duper
overview: On the night of a highly anticipated Super Duper Moon, two people embark on an intimate nighttime journey together. As clouds obscure the sky and the night stretches on, anticipation gives way to waiting, uncertainty, and presence. With the spectacle they planned for absent, the meaning of the evening must be negotiated through behavior, silence, and choice—revealing whether love is sustained by symbols or by staying.

title: Hauntshow
overview: The twisted final broadcast of an underground variety show. A mysterious, macabre, deviant and delinquent double-bill of chillers hosted by Hauntrella, Hauntressa and the dearly departed Hauntiana.

title: Final Press
overview: Workers at The Minnesota Star Tribune complete the last run of the newspaper's Heritage printing plant bringing an end to 150 years of printing the paper in Minnesota.

title: Hyperscaled
overview: Focused on Alabama's "Project Marvel," this documentary unearths the real world cost of AI as residents fight to get answers about the costly impacts of proposed datacenters.

title: Kameleon 3
overview: When the inseparable twins Hielke and Sietse Klinkhamer discover that a mysterious criminal is plotting an attack on the world-famous Ir. D.F. Wouda Pumping Station, a nerve-wracking race against time begins.

title: Magnacamp
overview: A look at a successful camp months after a zombie apocalypse.

title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
original_title: I Think My Dad's a Cyborg and I Think He Killed My Mum
overview: A lonely year after his mother’s death, awkward hermit Peter is still no closer to his father, and he thinks he knows the reason why; a reason which he must confront at the family gathering before the secret spirals out of control...his dad MUST be a murderous cyborg.

title: Okay? Alright.
overview: A reclusive Filipino-Korean man travels back in time to kill his pregnant mother in hopes of ceasing to exist. But in doing so, he obtains a certain hope that his life will turn out okay.

title: Violent Delight
overview: A lonely artist draws her perfect companion-but the more he sees her, the more she loses herself.

title: Binding Eva
overview: Deep in an English forest, a man on the run returns again and again to the same moment of judgement, and the same impossible choice.

title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
original_title: You Fuckers Figure It Out: A Jason Molina Story
overview: Conjure the spirit of indie-rock icon Jason Molina (1973-2013) with Ohio insiders who illuminate Truth about his coming of age on Lake Erie, escaping artless steel town indifference, and manifesting the legendary band, Songs: Ohia, as they celebrate contradictions that tether Jason’s raunchy humor, propensity to lie, refusal to interpret lyrics, and untimely death into a haunting legacy unconfined by the record vault.

title: Erased
overview: When confronted by the now 18-year-old son he dismissed before birth, a high-powered businessman must decide between their potential relationship and a life changing financial opportunity.

title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
original_title: Echoes of The Forks of Cypress
overview: Echoes of Forks of Cypress explores the lives of the enslaved and enslavers at the Forks of Cypress plantation in Florence, AL. The documentary highlights their struggles, resilience, and the plantation’s historical significance. It then shifts to the present, where descendants from both sides come together to confront and heal from their shared past.

title: Magic 8
overview: 1974. A Smoke filled Sports Bar. Love is like a game of pool. “Magic 8” is a 3 minute short film shot on Super 8, which explores what happens when making a queer connection in a stereotypically “Straight” space. It follows two men (referred to as Solid and Stripe), who engage in a game of 8-Ball Pool. As an audience we get the impression this is a regular occurrence for our two characters, but there is a mutual understanding that none of Solid’s inner dialogue could ever be said out loud.

title: Five Years in 8mm
overview: Shot on nostalgic Super-8 film, this home-movie-style documentary follows the director's gender transition within their NYC queer community, tracing a journey where joy emerges as a radical antidote to pain. At its heart, this short film is a love letter to young trans and non-binary people.

title: Fork in the Road
overview: Fork in the Road is an intimate documentary that explores the profound connections between people, the land, and the future of our food system. Through a tapestry of compelling stories from independent small-scale farmers across the United States, from Alaskan kelp harvesters to dairy farmers in Kentucky, the film reveals the authentic, lived realities and unprecedented challenges of those working against the tide of escalating industrialization in agriculture. Featuring insights from visionary chefs and culinary experts, Fork in the Road expands the conversation beyond the farm, demonstrating how food sustainability is a shared responsibility that extends into our kitchens and communities. More than a call to environmental action, the film illuminates the vital ways that sustainable food practices can nourish our bodies, strengthen our communities, and heal the Earth.

title: Radio 11:11 Part-2 : The Origin
overview: It reveals the origin of the mystery — the story of Arvind Mehra, Arjun Mehra and the creation of Tempora. After Arjun mysteriously disappears during the machine’s first activation, Arvind’s research leads to Radio 11:11 and its strange connection with lightning and time. What happened to Arvind that night, and why does the mystery repeat every 11 years? The answers begin to unfold in 2026.

title: Batman: The Complexity in the Shadows
original_title: Batman: The Complexity in the Shadows
overview: As Batman continues his fight against Gotham’s underworld, Deathstroke enters the conflict with his own agenda. With dangerous enemies, old scars and new threats emerging from the darkness, the line between justice and vengeance becomes increasingly blurred.

title: She'll Be Apples
overview: When Noah, a susceptible teen, becomes accquainted with a group with a questionable reputation, his approach to handling family, friendship, “love” adolescence and religion is heavily influenced.

title: Fire & Ice
overview: A musical western.

title: RevPro 14 Year Anniversary Show
overview: Fourteen years of world-class action from Europe’s number one wrestling producers have led to this. On Saturday 29th August 2026, RevPro takes over the iconic OVO ARENA WEMBLEY for its biggest celebration yet—uniting the finest British and international talent for one unforgettable night. Expect championship clashes, dream matches, and the unmatched energy only RevPro fans bring.

title: The Wrong Housemaid
overview: After vanishing from her violent husband's grasp ten years ago, Mona thought she had finally secured a peaceful new life for herself and her teenage daughter, Denise, behind carefully crafted new identities. But their fragile safety shatters when a seemingly harmless housemaid enters their home and begins manipulating their lives with chilling precision.

title: The Pickleball Racket
overview: Disgraced councilwoman of Busterville, Ethel Wilton, finds herself at the center of a pickleball conspiracy. She decides the only way to save her city is to stop the citywide pickleball tournament with the help of her unlikely friends.

title: Gaskins: The Hitchhiker Killer
overview: South Carolina serial killer Donald “Pee-Wee” Gaskins carried out a reign of terror marked by extreme brutality. He stabbed, shot, drowned, and poisoned victims from his own community as well as hitchhikers, often targeting the vulnerable. Beneath the rural land near his home, bodies lay hidden in shallow graves, concealing years of violence. His history of crime masked the depth of his cruelty—until authorities uncovered the truth, exposing the full horror of his murders.

title: Echo Point
overview: A man inherits a secluded cabin from his estranged father. Inside, he discovers an old radio emitting strange, eerie signals. As he begins to unravel the truth, he realises the voices on the other end belong to the victims of a killer.

title: Dead Janitors Club
overview: Dead Janitors Club is a dark comedy crime film adapted from Jeff Klima's real-life memoir, The Dead Janitors Club: Pathetically True Tales of a Crime Scene Cleanup King. The story follows crooked cop Dirk (Jake Busey) and his cash-strapped partner Jeff Klima (Felix Merback) as they run a risky, illicit side-hustle cleaning up crime scenes. Things spiral violently out of control when Jeff lifts a mysterious safe from a bloody crime scene, not realizing it belongs to a dangerous drug cartel. At the same time, Jeff falls for Kerry (Brianna Gage), a tattoo artist who is quickly dragged into the crosshairs.

title: Meet the Josh
overview: Josh, a disgraced marine, moves to LA to follow his dream of making a fourth Meet the Parents movie. Along with his sleazy manager, Josh devises schemes to break into the entertainment industry and get his script to Ben Stiller.

title: The Show Must Go On
overview: A macro short that is a psychological thriller of a day in the life of a showgirl.

title: POA
overview: In the wake of overturning Obergefell v. Hodges., a wife and her mother-in-law are faced with conflicting interests pertaining to the well being of their spouse and daughter.

title: Mr. Lavender
overview: Set in 1950, this espionage thriller focuses on Peter Denton, a closeted KGB spy working undercover in the U.S. State department, as he strives to keep his carnal affair with his KGB handler hidden. When a top secret FBI task force abducts him for questioning, Peter must decide to bluff or fold

title: In Her Name
overview: Sixteen-year-old Joanie begins to question her sexuality after an intimate game of truth or dare at her best friend's birthday party.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: wabi_
overview: Trapped in his nostalgia and haunted by the impermanence of things, a sad little ghost is unable to pass through the liminal space he occupies.

title: Bringing Griffin Back
overview: A woman struggling with the absence of her fiance looks for a way to bring him back. Luckily, something hidden deep in her basement offers a solution.

title: Slay
overview: A killer on the loose targets a group of teenagers on spring break.

title: Paroxysm
overview: After a drug deal goes horribly wrong, Celia is pulled into a surreal odyssey of self-discovery. Drifting through a distorted world, she encounters temptation, desire, and paranoia as her sense of self begins to unravel and the line between reality and fantasy begin to blur around her

title: Weedkiller
overview: Weedkiller is a Welsh B-movie and indie SOV horror feature written and directed by filmmaker Tom Hughes. The film follows a humble gardener who goes on a violent rampage to rescue his beloved plants after a gang hijacks his allotment. The movie, described as a genre banger packed with chaos and attitude, draws inspiration from campy classics like The Toxic Avenger.

title: Lengwìa
overview: After an agonizing school year bruises his relationship with his well-liked older brother Jonah, socially awkward Teddy meets Cole, a disarming boy, by chance on the street. As their friendship deepens, actions begin to speak louder than words, unraveling the fragile balance between brotherhood, belonging, and yearning during a blistering summer break.

title: Doorman
overview: On a first date, a young woman gets herself entangled with a man who is desperate to stay in her life no matter how far he has to go.

title: Full Fat
overview: Grace and Bels live together, do everything together, have slept together – but Grace is queer, and Bels is not, so when faced with Bels’s new boyfriend, how long before she just loses it?

title: For Deer Life
overview: Beneath the beauty of spring lies a brutal tragedy… The birth of roe deer fawns coincides with the mowing season in Austria’s meadows, leading to a brutal struggle between nature and modern agriculture. “For Deer Life” tells the story of the dedicated drone operators, who put their heart and soul into rescuing the lives of as many fawns as possible. The film highlights the powerful combination of innovative use of thermal drones and the unwavering commitment of volunteers, to prevent this tragic loss of life. With the aim to inspire both a local and global audience to embrace technology as a conservation means, emphasising the harmonious balance between agriculture and wildlife protection.

title: April 30th
overview: Two dates in one night rarely made Victoria blink. Tonight, she should have kept her eyes wide open.

title: Dirty Fuzz
overview: When an idealistic rookie cop accidentally shoots her corrupt partner in the slimy underbelly of Shit City, she must team up with a surprising crew of underworld characters to cover her tracks.

title: The House
overview: After a heart attack, Jovan, a retired architect of Serbian origin who spent most of his life in Germany, refuses to give into his daughter's pressure to spend the rest of his life in a nursing home. With his grandson Nikola, who has Asperger's syndrome and is living without social contacts, he travels to his homeland, a village in Serbia, to sell the family land, but becomes a part of a local population rebellion against the construction mafia that threatens to destroy everything that is left of his homeland.

title: ROH: Death Before Dishonor 2026
overview: The 2026 Death Before Dishonor was an professional wrestling live streaming event produced by the American promotion Ring of Honor (ROH). It was the 23rd Death Before Dishonor event and took place on Friday, August 21, 2026, at the 2300 Arena in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The show was broadcast on both HonorClub and MyAEW (for international subscribers).

title: Hellmare
overview: The year is 1997, and on a gloomy evening in Detroit a group of friends are sucked into a horror movie when they gather at the house of a recently deceased occultist to screen a film entitled...HELLMARE.

title: Girl Dad
overview: A tough, queer teenager leaves Brooklyn for the first time to spend the summer with her estranged, struggling composer father in Los Angeles. The two are forced to reconnect over a used refrigerator, that nearly upends and further strains their father-daughter relationship in the process.

title: The Lounge
overview: Unfairly overlooked employee Liz wants to become a successful corporate creature.

title: Only in Moonlight
overview: A vampire stumbles into a nightclub, and tries to satiate his new blood lust while struggling to adjust to his supernatural disposition.

title: Miss You, Love You
overview: Forced to plan her late husband's funeral with her estranged gay son's assistant, a blunt, grieving widow forms an unlikely bond with the total stranger as confronting their shared grief surfaces deep family secrets and long-held resentments.

title: Joan of Arc
overview: A vague light flickers in the distance.

title: Tomorrow's Dreams  Short Demo
overview: Short Demo  ...  private request only

title: Any Minute Now
overview: In a quiet university accommodation, a group of flatmates spiral into anxious chaos as the clock strikes ten.

title: Baignade Interdite
overview: Stop bullying

title: Thiefish
overview: A thief and a fisherman work together to steal a fish spirit being used as an energy source in order to return it to the ocean.

title: A Life in Colour
overview: Lucy, an aspiring artist escapes into dreamlike visions through mysterious vials. As fantasy consumes her, she must choose which world to live in.

title: Play or Get Played
overview: Ava Cooper is caught in a web of love, betrayal, and hidden secrets as a dangerous affair forces her to question everyone around her.

title: Achilles Returns
overview: After many years, with help of Thetis and negotiations between Zeus and Hades, the Greek hero Achilles is released from the Underworld into the modern world.

title: Ink Between the Lines
overview: After the devastating suicide of her best friend Coli, 15 year old Natalie turns to journaling to cope with her overwhelming grief. Struggling with guilt and isolation, she pours her emotions onto the page and joins a support group for teens. A deep conversation with Ezra, a friend who understands silent pain, inspires her to transform her journal entries into a novel. As Natalie writes, she begins to confront hidden truths about her friendship with Coli, unspoken struggles, and the weight of what was left unsaid. Through storytelling, she finds healing, connection, and the courage to speak the truth—not just for herself, but for others who need to hear it.

title: The Salish Whistler Experience
overview: The chaos of Ècole Salish Secondarys trip to the Con Brio Festival in Whistler.

title: annually
overview: Years after drifting apart, two former lovers reunite at their old school for what may be their final day together. As they wander through parks, woodlands and riverside paths, Summer and Mia attempt to navigate the space between friendship and the feelings they never truly left behind. But beneath the awkward laughter, shared memories, and unfinished conversations lies the painful understanding that some relationships can survive everything, except time.

title: OUT
overview: After learning an online friend is considering suicide, Makoto, a young non-binary hikikomori, must try to save her while remaining trapped at home due to fear of the outside world.

title: GOOD JOB.
overview: A young man struggles to secure an entry level job.

title: The Eulogy
overview: In the aftermath of a family memorial, two siblings clash over a troubling discovery.

title: Uhambo Luka Liren
overview: When Liren loses her home to the flames of the fearsome dragon Kenf, she will embark on a journey in search of revenge—for what do you have left when you have lost everything? Will a joyful melody ever emerge from her flute again?
